_comment: Gate registry for new-gate attribution (design §5a). Read by the version-delta banner (hooks/banner.py) to ANNOUNCE a gate as new when its `since` falls in the (last_seen, current] range a repo crosses, and by the Stop hook (bin/prawduct-hook cmd_stop) to ATTRIBUTE a blocking message to the version + gate that caused it. `since` is the plugin version that introduced the gate; foundational gates that predate semver versioning carry `1.0.0`. This file ships inside the plugin, so adding a gate (and its attribution) creates no diff in any consuming repo. Release process: when a release adds an enforcing gate, append it here with `since` = that release's version, so the banner announces it on the bump and blocking messages flag it NEW.

gates.name: reflection
gates.summary: a session that changed judgeable code must capture a shaped reflection before session end — what was expected vs. what was actual, and a root cause or "no defect"

gates.name: critic-review
gates.summary: composed review coverage (evidence-store facts) must span this session's changes with zero unresolved blocking findings

gates.name: pr-review
gates.summary: PR review evidence is required before a PR merges

gates.name: trivial-declaration
gates.summary: Type: trivial chunks must satisfy the fileset + rationale bounds

gates.name: learnings-cutover
gates.summary: a repo still holding the legacy learnings corpus must run learnings-migrate before code work ends the session

gates.name: learnings-budget
gates.summary: a .claude/rules/learnings/ file over its byte budget and grown this session must pay from duplication or raise the budget with a reason

gates.name: learnings-budget-reason
gates.summary: a learnings_budgets: override in project-state.yaml must carry a reason
